fixtures.scenario: A body without new_password is refused by the schema at the member before any authority is judged.

fixtures.name: delete_session_authentication_required

fixtures.name: deny_device_login_code_required

fixtures.name: get_current_user_ok

fixtures.name: get_system_info_ok
